items.summary: Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and reject sitemap, monetization, public-launch, and production work this cycle. Evidence shows a password gate, noindex/nofollow, zero reported SEO activity, unavailable analytics and Data Hub sources, incomplete attribution, and unverified legal, accuracy, privacy, and security controls. Owner decision: choose keep-private, bounded beta, or full launch.

items.summary: Retain and escalate the launch-readiness proposal. Keep the site private; do not authorize sitemap work, public exposure, monetization expansion, or production changes until the owner selects a disposition and the applicable legal, security, accuracy, attribution, margin, and rollback gates are evidenced.
